summary: Run a local script through an explicit interpreter, with IDEL policy/logging around it.

args.description: Optional script arguments as one command-line string.

shell.description: Interpreter to use. auto picks from the file extension where possible.

node.semanticNotes: The runtime resolves and validates the script path, then spawns an interpreter with an argv array and shell:false. It does not parse or trust the script contents; policy should gate this command in sensitive environments.
